decisions.reason: As a product line with its own page and a direct extension of the established format portfolio, its continuation cost remains low and its option value is still tied to unresolved format demands.
The digital twin service still targets an emerging market with high uncertainty and builds on our existing offer, so the option remains cheap to hold.

Authentication and identity delegation remains close to existing services with low marginal cost, but after another year without stronger signals we raise the drop probability while keeping the option.
The consulting workshop has its own page and builds on established expertise, so we keep the new option open while demand for geodata business process consulting remains uncertain.
